messages:
mara (PM): quick sync 5 lock down roll-forward tolerances for the new feature-flag gating (we're calling it gated_flow_v1). want brakes that prioritize availability + gradual quality validation. sharing a compact plan.

dan (Eng): ok to prioritise availability. question: do we support per-route vs global gating? i vote per-route for high-risk endpoints and global for low-risk ones.

lee (SRE): suggested circuit set: p95>600ms for 5m OR error%>1.0 for 3m triggers soft-shed; p95>900ms or error%>2.0 for 2m => hard rollback. Soft-shed routes to degraded model variant; hard rollback disables flag entirely. Also recommend "safety leash" that prevents >10% ramp without 2FA approval.

tara (Data): metrics to track: p50/p95, error%, fidelity_score, token_cost_change, and support_tickets flag. propose an automated quality gate: fidelity_score drop >2% across cohort => hold ramp.

ana (Design): (ana) UX guidance: when a route is in soft-shed we should show a microcopy "result adjusted for peak performance". Keep it unobtrusive.

ship-bot: release window opened for gated_flow_v1: 2026-06-01T08:00Z.

mara (PM): ramp proposal: 0% -> 1% (1h) -> 5% (6h) -> 15% (24h) -> 50% (48h) -> 100%. quality gates at each step. owners: dan infra, tara metrics, lee runbook.

dan (Eng): will add CLI helper: `redwood rollout set gated_flow_v1 --route /generate --pct 5 --variants primary,backup` and PR for the flag schema.

tara (Data): will create a dashboard tile with alert rules: auto-hold if fidelity_drop>2% OR p95 delta>30% vs baseline.

lee (SRE): will add step-by-step in runbook for soft-shed -> hard rollback and include the commands to disable the flag and to rehydrate caches. will also schedule a chaos drill next week.

mara (PM): action items recap: dan -> flag PR + CLI (due Fri); tara -> dashboard & thresholds (due Fri); lee -> runbook updates & drill (due Mon); ana -> UX microcopy + banner spec (due Thu). I'll prepare customer comms for early adopters. :rocket:
